description: Sprint burndown plot. Wraps <chart-wc> with auto-computed ideal line and scope-change annotations. All attributes are observed: changing one on a live element re-renders.

attributes.name: start
attributes.description: Sprint start date (YYYY-MM-DD, local calendar day; required)

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Display unit for the y-axis and scope-change notes (rendered as text)

attributes.name: weekends
attributes.description: Whether weekends count toward the ideal-line slope

structure.description: Inline data source: <tr> rows with cells [date YYYY-MM-DD, remaining, optional ±delta scope-change]

events.name: burndown-chart:ready
events.description: Fired after each upgrade (first connect, reconnect, or a retried upgrade), in a microtask. Not re-fired when a live attribute change re-renders
